cases.name: a confirm over a sheet: Escape closes the confirm only, then the sheet
a doubled Escape resolves to one absolute close, so a redelivery closes nothing more
closing a lower entry closes everything opened over it
a required prompt ignores Escape and its backdrop
a backdrop click on a layer that is no longer on top does nothing
reopening an open id moves it to the top with its new fields
a payload that is not plain JSON, or an unknown policy, is ignored
